title: Initial Build Offer · All Hail King Jesus ↔ Corgi Loaf Baking Co.

targetAssets.name: 2027 2nd · Badlands · Projected Late · original owner Badland Banditos

analysis.executiveSummary: All Hail King Jesus seeks to acquire DeVonta Smith and a 2027 2nd-round pick (Badland Banditos) from Corgi Loaf Baking Co. using Tee Higgins as the foundation asset. In a 16-team PPR league, Tee Higgins (86.8 C-AVI / 91.6 D-AVI) and DeVonta Smith (84.9 C-AVI / 91.9 D-AVI) sit in the exact same high-end WR2/WR1 tier. However, asking an Elite Contender like Corgi Loaf Baking Co. to surrender a valuable 2027 2nd-round pick (48.5 AVI) for a marginal +1.9 C-AVI starting upgrade is an imbalanced deal that Corgi's front office will reject. To make the transaction realistic while advancing All Hail King Jesus's goal of increasing championship odds, AVI recommends revising the offer by adding a 2029 2nd-round pick to balance draft capital and create a clean 2-year pick acceleration.

submitted.summary: The submitted offer strongly favors All Hail King Jesus, who swaps Tee Higgins for DeVonta Smith while extracting a premium 2027 2nd-round pick to restock depleted draft capital. recommended.summary: Including a 2029 2nd-round pick alongside Tee Higgins converts the transaction into a mutually beneficial pick-acceleration trade. All Hail King Jesus pulls forward draft capital into 2027 while securing DeVonta Smith, and Corgi Loaf Baking Co. upgrades its starting WR slot (+1.9 C-AVI) without suffering net loss of 2nd-round draft capital.
